notes: Boot harl_a40 with built-in mechanisms disabled (--handle-mechanics 0), four balls on trough switches 11-14, the Motor Down switch 36 at public 1 and the Motor Up switch 35 at 0. Insert three coins, press Start and emulate the serve and the auto launch, then close no playfield switch. Move the bike by hand at fixed times: three seconds after the ball leaves the shooter lane lower 36 and raise 35 three seconds later; 29 s later lower 35 and raise 36 two seconds later; 24 s later lower 36 and raise 35 again. Record when the ROM energizes and drops the motor relay (solenoid 19) against those switch changes.
